```{r}
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Highway Fuel Economy by Engine Displacement",
    x = "Engine displacement (liters)",
    y = "Highway miles per gallon",
    color = "Vehicle class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
